question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now compute the average of these totals
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        r.id AS root_id,
        r.id AS current_id,
        CAST(r.id AS VARCHAR) AS path,
        1 AS depth,
        1 AS cumulative_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id AS id FROM packaging_relations 
        EXCEPT 
        SELECT DISTINCT contains_id AS id FROM packaging_relations
    ) r
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.path || ' -> ' || pr.contains_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT contains_id AS id FROM packaging_relations
    EXCEPT
    SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
),
leaf_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.current_id AS leaf_id,
        pt.cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN leaf_items li ON li.id = pt.current_id
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(cumulative_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM leaf_quantities
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS average_total_quantity
FROM root_totals
